title: GTA 6 Features Creepy IT the Clown Hotel Easter Egg
description: According to media reports, GTA 6 features a creepy IT the Clown surprise waiting inside one of its hotels, adding a spooky easter egg for players to discover.
author: GTA6 Hub Editorial
content:
## Uncovering the Spooky IT the Clown Easter Egg in GTA 6

As the gaming community eagerly anticipates more details about Rockstar Games' upcoming blockbuster, new discoveries continue to emerge. According to a recent report by GameRant, GTA 6 features a creepy IT the Clown surprise waiting inside one of its hotels, offering a spooky treat for players exploring the open world.

### A Tradition of Hidden Surprises

Rockstar Games has long been celebrated for packing its virtual worlds with intricate easter eggs, pop culture references, and nods to classic horror cinema. From mysterious urban legends to subtle cinematic nods, hunting for hidden details has always been a staple of the player experience in the franchise. The discovery of this horror-inspired hotel surprise highlights the meticulous attention to detail embedded throughout the game's environment.

While players will have to venture into the specific hotel location themselves to fully experience the creepy encounter, details like this demonstrate how the developers continue to blend atmospheric storytelling and unexpected thrills into the open-world sandbox.

### Editor's Take

Rockstar's penchant for horror references always adds an extra layer of fun to their open worlds. Finding a creepy clown surprise tucked away in a hotel room proves that danger and dark humor can lurk around any corner in this game. Keep your eyes open while exploring!
